observations: All 29 final screenshots individually inspected using view_image; no image-equivalence substitution in this UI review.

Desktop task cards and catalogue columns are readable; 375/390 and 640x450 reflow stack naturally. No observed overlay, blank main content, broken images, text overlap or horizontal clipping in captured viewports.
T04 aspect square/slide evidence links, version labels, fixture scope and known short-tail limitation remain visible at all four viewports.
All eight aspect groups and their 48 native links checked by the browser in both JavaScript states; all 59 preview images decoded. No new template count.
No-JavaScript catalogue and native details remain usable. Browser cleanup passed on the final run.
boundaries: Screenshots cover section starts and representative details, not every pixel of every item.
200% is equivalent reflow, not native browser menu zoom.
No screen-reader, cross-browser or full contrast certification.
Card acceptance is separately scoped to exact original inputs and CI font environment; this local UI run does not certify Windows card rendering.
